links.to_node: make passengers vote for 10 passengers to send overboard
My passengers hold a vote to decide which 10 passengers will leave the lifeboat.
The 10 passengers sent overboard freeze to death
The remaining passengers in the overcrowded lifeboat have a higher chance of survival
Tension and distress arise among passengers due to the vote and its consequences
I face moral and ethical consequences for ordering the vote and sending passengers overboard
